summary: The real API and adapter executed against a fake inference provider configured to time out. The provider is material to the claim and was replaced, which is what puts this record at C1.

substitutions.rationale: The claim is about what the API does when the provider times out, so the provider had to be controlled. Replacing it is what the record may not be read past.

results.statement: The API returned the canonical timeout response with a retryable flag.

limitations: The provider was a fake. Making it more faithful would not change what the record establishes.
doesNotEstablish: That the real inference runtime behaves this way under a real timeout.
